Hi Jordan,

Thanks for reaching out — we can definitely support your order of 20 EN-100 sensor enclosures.

We don't currently have finished EN-100 units in stock since they're built from sub-components. However, our shell, gasket, and heat-set insert stock is sufficient; we only need to receive a small replenishment of lids (12 pcs) and screws (30 pcs) from our supplier Demo Supply Co. before we can run the build.

- **Purchase order placement** — today / tomorrow once you confirm go-ahead.
- **Supplier lead time for lids & screws** — typically 5–7 business days.
- **Build + QC (assembly, gasket fit, torque check of inserts)** — 2–3 business days after parts arrive.

Estimated ship date: **~10–14 business days from today**, assuming no delays on the supplier side.

Once we have your go-ahead we'll raise the PO immediately and keep you posted. Let me know if you'd like us to proceed or if you have any questions in the meantime.

Best regards,
MakerOps Team
